note: Read by arrangement. The first source; its guards are the ones every other source inherits. The id is boyceville, NOT bigriver-boyceville: the id is the output filename (data/<id>.json) and data/boyceville.json is what the Emmert Worker reads. Renaming it would disconnect both sites silently.
inMergeWhy: Barchart already carries Boyceville, and more fully (beans plus a second corn program). Read for the Emmert sites, which consume data/boyceville.json directly; excluded from the AGSIST map so one elevator is not two rows.
